versions.name: Great Lakes Sailing Adventure (The Retriever)

features.note: Offshore sail training aboard the Retriever, a 52-foot ketch home-ported at Mackinaw City.
Crews bring their own food and cook it in the vessel's galley on a rotating galley-crew duty.

versions.summary: High-adventure sailing expedition aboard the Retriever, a 52-foot ketch based in Mackinaw City, Michigan, cruising the northern Great Lakes to destinations such as Mackinac Island, Beaver Island, and Charlevoix. Participants learn sail trim, helmsmanship, navigation, and marine safety.
